steps.name: Install Chromium before unit and end-to-end browser tests

decodedLogEvidence.method: Actual decoded GitHub job log fetched through the authorized GitHub connector after completion; saved as UTF-8 with LF newlines. No storage redirect workaround, guessed log or reconstructed test output.

cloudflareCheckoutProof.method: Actual Cloudflare build log HEAD marker, matching deployment full commit metadata and canonical production state. WWW is the existing redirect project, not an Astro build.

batchHttpsVerification.method: Actual HTTPS GET through inherited proxy and CA trust using standard Node fetch/TLS. No proxy bypass, browser fixtures, third-party provider requests, API writes, paid services, indexation requests or retries after source failures.

limitations: Expected/local source commit is a guard, not Cloudflare deployment identity evidence. Root verifies both actual project deployments separately.
Googlebot UA checks use this executor network address, not an authenticated Googlebot IP; they do not prove a Google crawl, indexing or ranking.
Search HTTP checks verify serialized published IDs and crawlable links; root independently tests live React behavior and mobile/desktop navigation.
All reviewed optimized new public photo files are compared against exact reviewed SHA256. Original archival source files remain local and are not claimed as publicly served.
No source, publication metadata, article approvals, tests, configs, advertisements, credentials or Cloudflare settings are mutated by this helper.

method.firstParty: Real HTTPS GET with inherited proxy and CA verification, unmodified response bodies/CSP replayed into Chromium; same resource cached within this QA only.
method.externalProviders: Isolated in the browser only to prevent ad impressions and Analytics; these are functional checks and are not speed metrics.
method.consent: Denied via browser initialization, never granted.
method.search: Actual Home GET form and linked Search result cards; Home has no autocomplete implementation. React filtering was exercised by changing the query and changing it back.

findings: All eight guide language/device screenshots were actually viewed: legible localized headings and summary, expected cover photograph, preserved navy header and3D logo.

No clipped header/brand, menu overlap with header controls, distorted images or horizontal overflow observed. Mobile dropdown intentionally overlays page content; its links remain unobstructed, as separately measured.

All six search/menu screenshots were viewed; visible localized search results and existing globe presentation preserved. Functional QA changed the React query, followed both new cards and switched to each paired translation.
The source-photo contact sheets and all40optimizednewvariants were inspected separately before approval; these are fourteen actual public browser screenshots.
